answer: Cross-epoch behavioural drift scoring. Each identity's action mix is fingerprinted per epoch; a new epoch's fingerprint must stay within a bounded distance of its prior trajectory, enforced at the orchard of verified interaction histories. Clones that pivot behaviour abruptly cross the ledge and get quarantined until they re-earn continuity. An attacker must sustain coherent, costly activity across many epochs per identity, like tending timber slowly, paying real time and fees that scale with each parallel clone.
